title: 2565. Subsequence With the Minimum Score

examples.explanation: In this example, we remove the character "z" at index 1 (0-indexed). The string t becomes "baa" which is a subsequence of the string "abacaba" and the score is 1 - 1 + 1 = 1. It can be proven that 1 is the minimum score that we can achieve.

In this example, we remove characters "x", "y" and "z" at indices 0, 1, and 2 (0-indexed). The string t becomes "" which is a subsequence of the string "cde" and the score is 2 - 0 + 1 = 3. It can be proven that 3 is the minimum score that we can achieve.

hints: Maintain two pointers: i and j. We need to perform a similar operation: while t[0:i] + t[j:n] is not a subsequence of the string s, increase j.
We can check the condition greedily. Create the array leftmost[i] which denotes minimum index k, such that in prefix s[0:k] exists subsequence t[0:i]. Similarly, we define rightmost[i].
If leftmost[i] < rightmost[j] then t[0:i] + t[j:n] is the subsequence of s.
